name: Theodore Roosevelt
desc: 26th President of the United States from 1901 to 1909 (1858–1919)
summary: Theodore Roosevelt Jr. (October 27, 1858 – January 6, 1919) was the 26th president of the United States, serving from 1901 to 1909. A member of the Republican Party and the 25th vice president, he assumed the presidency after President William McKinley was assassinated.
